decision: Retain post-producer SSA value compaction; exact generated code and complete metadata preserved on both separately matched bases

command.scope: Separate diagnostic complete compile with CPU samples; excluded from primary timing.
Diagnostic CPU sampling only; excluded from primary timing.

hardware: Apple M3 Air, 8 cores (4P+4E), 16 GB, macOS 26.2
scope: Sixteen serial fresh source-to-Object primary observations: eight on the historical 55-flag base and eight on the latest 60-flag base. Each uses ABBA then BAAB order. Configurations and different generated programs are kept separate, never pooled. No cached Object or decoded-only substitute is used.

Builds, tests, both screens, fixtures, profiling, copying, hashing and archiving do not overlap primary timing. Compaction cost is included in cleanup_including_compaction_seconds and in every compiler/whole-process total.

The builder has finished and discarded all external Value handles before compaction. Aliases are flattened with the unchanged resolver; every reference is remapped before retired IDs are released. Original definition order, instruction/block identities, effects, layout, debug-label policy, current ownership checks and resource proofs remain. No semantic/factory/permission result is cached.

All source, MBC, Object and complete metadata bytes match between subjects within each base. Both bases pass fourteen fixture pairs and the same seven production tests, including 65 supported exact native-code pairs and a million-alias stress case. The multi-result IR fixture is verified without claiming unsupported I32-isplit machine lowering.

The current control reproduces the independently qualified short-reduction Object 8a4c2b17... from PR 973 source 1c09216698.... Its five new switches are enabled identically for both current subjects. Original 55-flag observations and output pins remain separately available.

Both balanced blocks improve mean compiler time on each base. Overall elapsed ranges overlap and adverse RSS/footprint and unchanged-stage observations remain. These finite cohorts are descriptive, not population estimates. No selective best-run timing is used.

The initial output-identical prototype, the two tightened metadata counterexamples, build/fixture corrections and intermediate passing tests remain with their exact patches and logs. Compiler executables are excluded and hash-pinned. Rebuilds and cached lookups are recorded without a cold-bootstrap claim.

Both separate CPU profiles retain raw/mapped stacks, output bytes, commands, self-count tables, existing demangler source/pin and any unsuccessful sampling attempts. Main-thread waits are not CPU work; samples are not stage-exclusive elapsed time or exact source-line attribution.

No new program-runtime latency campaign is claimed: generated machine code and complete metadata are byte-identical within each matched base. Grammar, language, direct scalar emission, checked errors, finite admission and backend optimization levels are unchanged. Full compilation remains above ten seconds.
